entities.name: Fiddler’s Green
entities.source_summary: Irish-themed family pub popular with police, veterans and local edgerunners, serving SCOP-based pub food, imported stout and occasional real soda bread; the proprietor also informally holds packages and messages for regulars.

services.label: Informal package and message holding for regular customers

entities.name: Greta’s
entities.source_summary: Long-running dive bar that evolved into a major Night City pool hall, with strong ties to its historic lesbian clientele and substantial drink sales around competitive play.
